_comment: Changing 'productName' moves the userData folder (%APPDATA%/<productName>), which holds the encrypted API key, settings, tutor memory, study log and PDF library — Electron derives that path from productName, not from 'name'. If it ever changes again, extend migrateLegacyUserData() in main.js to carry the data across.
name: voice-math-tutor-pc
description: Offline maths practice and screen-aware voice tutoring for Windows
author: Tynan Heperi
